content:
zoe: Quick PSA  migration created inconsistent anchors for headings with parentheses and emoji. e.g. `# Cleanup (batch) 🚀` produced both `cleanup-batch-rocket` and `cleanup-batch-` in different builds. Linkcheck started failing.

nate: Reproduced locally. The slugifier strips emoji differently depending on renderer. I sketched a tiny plugin to map emoji -> short names and to preserve alphanumeric inside parens.

irene: Can we avoid changing content? Prefer build-time normalization + a small redirects.json for extant variants.

nate: Plan: plugin normalizes unicode (NFC), maps emoji to names, collapses punctuation to single hyphens but preserves parentheses content when safe. Add `--emit-redirects` to tools/slugmap.py to collect historical variants.

ci-bot: linkcheck: branch/pr/4830  6 broken fragments reported. See: https://ci.redwood-inference.local/links/4830

docs-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview-4830.docs.redwood-inference.com/ (staging)

zoe: Good. Once staging is green, opt-in flag on prod, run global linkcheck, and add a short changelog note so support can triage anchor 404s.

irene: I'll run the collector across main and paste top variant counts here. If <50 we emit redirects; otherwise prioritize canonicalization.

nate: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4830 (WIP) 44d. Tests added for emoji and paren cases.
